description: This file contains the implementation of the DynamoDBClusteringProviderBuilder class, which configures DynamoDB clustering options for Orleans silos and clients using configuration settings.

classes.name: DynamoDBClusteringProviderBuilder
classes.description: Implements IProviderBuilder for ISiloBuilder and IClientBuilder to configure DynamoDB clustering options based on configuration settings.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures an ISiloBuilder or IClientBuilder with DynamoDB clustering options, reading values from the provided configuration section.
